scope: Private neutral founder voyages and multi-generation passports for actual inherited copies

implementation.design: Mist starts with six or 24 founders of each species. The six-founder group is nested in the 24-founder draw. Both use the same original 48 reference genotypes per species (p(A)=0.5, H=0.5), sampled with replacement. Repeated source genotypes belong to distinct founder identities. Ember and Tide start identically in the two private worlds.
implementation.controls: Private isolation or distance-dependent dispersal at scale 0.30; selection, reciprocal effects and mutation off; rainfall identical across islands. Both established populations produce 24 offspring of each species per round after the founding event. The existing breeding, dispersal and inheritance engine is unchanged.
implementation.interaction: Predict, draw boats, inspect native A/a tokens, grow or visit five private generations, open island connections, follow either species, compare p(A) or H, inspect exact data and save full reasoning to the journal. Plots and tables reveal only history through the visited generation.
implementation.ancestry: An allele passport traces the actually selected parental copy for every recorded generation back to G0. Trait and marker copy sampling are independent. Each row identifies the organism, copy, value, prior parent and island crossing; trait mutation draws are distinguished from resulting bounded values.
implementation.integration: Passports are available on founder boats, selected individuals in the main expedition, and actual newborns in private repeated field-study futures. Long routes support keyboard scrolling. Section navigation moves focus to the founder investigation.
implementation.census: Every current neutral-marker copy is assigned to its exact G0 founder identity and copy number. Counts conserve 2N copies, distinguish original local Mist lineages from outside founder origins, and count ancestry identities separately from A/a allele types.
implementation.persistence: A bounded versioned seed/batch/connection/generation recipe replays the study, without saving its full genealogy or trusting cached results. Prediction and reasoning drafts persist. New boat draws retain the fixed source pool and change the private sampling batch. Changing connections replays the same boats from G0.
implementation.boundaries: Founder worlds are explicitly private, cannot be restored or checkpointed as the main expedition, and never change its history or future randomness.

teachingBoundaries: This demonstrates a brief founding event, not a population permanently maintained at six individuals.

One nested paired draw is an example, not an independent-group sample, significance test or guaranteed effect. A particular six-founder draw can have a higher one-marker H than the 24-founder draw. Repeat before generalizing.
A founder-copy identity describes recorded ancestry. Multiple identities can carry the same allele letter or trait value; it is not a count of genetically distinct variants or genome-wide diversity.

The neutral A/a marker never mutates in this model. Under isolation, a locally lost allele letter cannot be recreated by population growth. Successful gene flow may introduce copies from elsewhere; arrival alone is insufficient.
Copy provenance stops at G0. The reference genotype pool is not a reconstructed genealogy before arrival.
The two private worlds share an initial breeding seed; later draw sequences may differ. Numerical IDs are private to a boat and connection setting.
Founder voyages use the original source pool, not the present expedition population. The main model still omits genome-wide complexity, resource-limited demography and speciation.

modelAndComponentChecks.checks: Nested genotype provenance, fixed source frequencies, unique identities, equal breeding weights, isolation, bounded recipes, actual trait/marker parent copies, mutation events, exact crossings, copy census conservation and main-RNG isolation.

renderGoldens.scope: Only the two EvoLab snapshot entries changed.

finalFounderRecheck.reason: Progressive outcome reveal, naturally sized cards and final passport screenshot.

browserJourneys.actual3D: One connected, non-lost WebGL context with real draw calls and no page errors in the founder journey.
browserJourneys.mobile: 390px phone, reduced motion, forced WebGL absence, keyboard-only draw/generation/connection/copy controls, focusable scrollable routes, no horizontal page overflow, and zero scoped axe WCAG 2 A/AA or 2.1 AA violations.
browserJourneys.evidence: Rendered p(A), founder census, founder passports, actual main-marker/trait ancestry, saved replay, full journal reasoning and main RNG/history preservation match the real model.

validation.visualReview: Reviewed desktop and phone founder voyages and the actual main-expedition allele passport; regression images were regenerated by the eight-journey run.

localization.mode: Fallback-aware keys prepared in the delta for the shared catalog owner; shared catalogs and translation packs remain untouched.

scientificReferences.title: UC Berkeley Understanding Evolution — Bottlenecks and founder effects
scientificReferences.usedFor: Founding samples can be unrepresentative and lose variation; numerical population recovery does not by itself restore lost inherited variation.
